title: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence - Computer Vision
institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

compensation.value: Full scholarship covering tuition, accommodation and health insurance, plus a monthly allowance (AED 8,000 per month for international and UAE-resident MSc students per the admissions overview)

about: MBZUAI's MSc in Computer Vision admits for fall 2027. The application portal opened 7 September 2026; the final deadline is 15 December 2026 (5 p.m. GST), with decisions by 31 March 2027. Full-time admits generally receive a full scholarship.
requirements: STEM bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale (other MBZUAI documents cite 3.2)
English test: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or PTE 60, among others, taken at a test center
Two referees, one academic and one work-related; GRE optional
One application per applicant per cycle

upskill.name: Computer Vision I
why: Field "Computer vision, artificial intelligence" → objective "Image classification: AlexNet (2012), VGG, ResNet, EfficientNet milestones"

Programme "Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence - Computer Vision" → objectives "Object detection: YOLO, R-CNN family, DETR" and "Image segmentation: semantic, instance, panoptic (Mask R-CNN, SAM)"
Requirement "STEM bachelor's degree" (Foundation level entry point) → Computer Vision I is the Foundation-level course that precedes Computer Vision II in the AI Foundations Academy
